author: Codex; AI-authored fictional professional profiles, not real applicants

families.employment_history: Two-paragraph work narrative: sustained role, responsibilities and limits; employment duration is explicit.
families.personal_portfolio: Portfolio of a personal or learning project: goal, implementation, verification; project time is not employment.
families.internship_log: Supervised internship: assigned work, mentor boundary and learning evidence; not full-time professional equivalence.
families.incident_case: Operational problem/case: symptom, investigation, correction, retrospective; role duration is separate from incident duration.
families.contract_handover: Bounded delivery/maintenance contract: scope, artifacts, acceptance, handover; contract months are not skill months.
families.incomplete_account: Professional notes with missing chronology: concrete actions and limitations; no duration inferred.

lineage_policy: Each scenario has its own fictional source. All ten profiles using one framework share template_group across occupations. Same-cohort authorship remains a limitation; six template groups are not six independent human data sources.
authoring_protocol: Write career scenarios from role/task knowledge without a target JD, ranking, relevance label or copying pilot text.
Use Vietnamese professional prose and technology names, without real identity, contacts or employer names.
Manually attach skills and scoped durations to exact sentences in the fictional text; unknown remains empty.
Version initial scenarios as v1 with no parent/variant; later rewrites must preserve source_group and template_group.
The renderer receives only these authored assets, never JD/ranking files. It does not generate random CV text.
Prospective means unused for feature/model tuning. Structural evidence validation is not professional verification.
data_analyst: Still in research scope; new benchmark entry waits for usable non-pilot JD. No Data Analyst CV included in this five-role batch.
